title: Shale took over Argentina's oil
takeaway: Unconventional wells produced 15 thousand m³ of oil in 2006 and 29.2 million in 2025. They overtook conventional output in 2023 and lifted the national total from its 2017 low of 28 million m³ to 46 million.
sql:
SET VARIABLE monthly_production = (
    SELECT list('https://huggingface.co/datasets/oskrgab/petrodb/resolve/main/argentina/monthly_production/' || path)
    FROM read_json('https://huggingface.co/datasets/oskrgab/petrodb/resolve/main/argentina/monthly_production/_files.json') AS manifest(path)
);

SELECT p.anio AS year,
       CASE w.tipo_recurso
           WHEN 'NO CONVENCIONAL' THEN 'Unconventional'
           WHEN 'CONVENCIONAL'    THEN 'Conventional'
           ELSE 'Not reported'
       END AS resource,
       sum(p.prod_pet) / 1e6 AS oil_million_m3
FROM read_parquet(getvariable('monthly_production'), hive_partitioning = true) AS p
JOIN 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/oskrgab/petrodb/resolve/main/argentina/wells.parquet' AS w USING (idpozo)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY year, resource;

title: Two basins for oil, a third for gas
takeaway: Totals for 2006 to 2025. Neuquina and Golfo San Jorge produced 90% of the oil. Gas is a different map: Neuquina leads, and Austral ranks second with only 4% of the oil.
sql:
SET VARIABLE monthly_production = (
    SELECT list('https://huggingface.co/datasets/oskrgab/petrodb/resolve/main/argentina/monthly_production/' || path)
    FROM read_json('https://huggingface.co/datasets/oskrgab/petrodb/resolve/main/argentina/monthly_production/_files.json') AS manifest(path)
);

SELECT w.cuenca AS basin,
       sum(p.prod_pet) / 1e6 AS oil_million_m3,
       sum(p.prod_gas) / 1e6 AS gas_billion_m3   -- prod_gas is in thousand m³
FROM read_parquet(getvariable('monthly_production'), hive_partitioning = true) AS p
JOIN 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/oskrgab/petrodb/resolve/main/argentina/wells.parquet' AS w USING (idpozo)
GROUP BY basin
HAVING oil_million_m3 >= 1 OR gas_billion_m3 >= 1
ORDER BY oil_million_m3 DESC;

title: More oil from fewer wells
takeaway: The number of wells that produced in a year peaked at 29,513 in 2016 and has drifted down since, while oil output rose: fewer wells, each producing more.
